name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-chocolate-island
title: Super Mario World - Chocolate Island
description:
With this, you can make your SMW-like mountain levels nicer looking! All of the original mountain background in Chocolate Island from SMW, now in layer 3.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.

Skewer Edit: You may want to use a sprite status bar patch with this one.
